EX-99.1 2 ex_1036873.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 ex_1036873.htm Exhibit 99.1 UroGen Reports $68.0 Million of ZUSDURI Revenue and Provides Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Highlights • ZUSDURI ® generated $68.0 million in revenue in the third quarter of 2026, representing 35% quarter-over-quarter growth • The FDA accepted UroGen ’ s NDA for UGN-103 (next-generation novel mitomycin-based formulation) for review; PDUFA goal date set for June 14, 2027 • Announced first patient dosed in the UGN-501 Phase 1 trial • Conference call and webcast to be held today at 10:00 AM ET PRINCETON, N.J., Nov. 4, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- UroGen Pharma Ltd.

Next-generation novel mitomycin-based formulations for urothelial cancer: • In October 2026, the FDA accepted for review UroGen’s NDA for UGN-103 and assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of June 14, 2027.

The increase in R&D expenses was primarily attributable to an increase in UGN-103 and UGN-104 clinical development costs, the PDUFA fee related to the UGN-103 NDA submission, and increased development costs related to UGN-501.
